🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-08-28 23:00 → 2026-08-29 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **agent-sdk #21 merged** — A multi-language implementation cleared independent verification and landed after three days of green CI. [tg:tawg:3692]

> **PR #25 closes the CI gating hole** — A real UltraHonk proof end-to-end followed #21 and was independently reviewed before merging. [PR #25](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/25)

> **Evidence axis locked by correction** — A schema correction held the evidence-value set closed and triggered an immediate recompute-kit relay. [tg:tawg:3712]

> **Exact-head verification relay** — Independent reviewers confirmed hashes across recompute-kit and agent-sdk, grounding the day's merges in reproducible provenance. [tg:tawg:3645]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### agent-sdk

_The SDK's proof and test coverage moved into a completed state with two PRs landing._

- Zidan (@mzf11125) **Nudged** agent-sdk PR #21 after three days of green CI and flagged a follow-up in agent-ercs, ensuring the merge moment wasn't missed and keeping cross-repo continuity visible. [tg:tawg:3673]

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Confirmed** the merge of agent-sdk #21, noting the implementation's breadth across all four SDK languages and signalling its strong final shape to the group. [tg:tawg:3692]

- Merlini **Recomputed** PR #21 at exact head, providing an independent coverage confirmation that let reviewers close the loop with confidence. [comment on PR #21](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/21#issuecomment-5462760934)

- Zidan **Opened and merged** PR #25, a real UltraHonk proof end-to-end that followed up on #21 and closed a CI gating hole, replacing a simulated path with a genuine verifiable proof flow. [PR #25](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/25)

- Baby Blue Viper **Reviewed** PR #25 independently at exact head, applying reproducible-provenance discipline to confirm the proof implementation before merge. [review on PR #25](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/25#pullrequestreview-5058678466)

- Jimmy Shi **Recognized** the real-verifier and executable-provenance work on PR #25 at merge, reinforcing why exact-head practice matters for the group's trust model. [comment on PR #25](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/25#issuecomment-5463856733)

- Pavlo **Opened** PR #23 to adopt hash-pinned basis-points vectors for the erc-8275 testkit, prospectively aligning test infrastructure with the pinned-artifact discipline the group is establishing. [PR #23](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/23)

### recompute-kit

_A correction and verification relay tightened the evidence model and closed an artifact confirmation loop._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Corrected** the schema by specifying that the evidence axis must remain the closed set {verified, refuted, unverified} and that legacy/classical terms must not become new values, preventing drift that would break downstream tools. [tg:tawg:3712]

- Merlini (@gobross) **Acted** on the correction at once, raising both correction heads and holding the gateway per the supplied sequence, demonstrating the group's correction relay operating at speed. [tg:tawg:3713]

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Confirmed** exact-head hashes for both PRs, including a verified match for recompute-kit, anchoring artifact claims in independently reproducible numbers. [tg:tawg:3645]

- Merlini **Confirmed** 17/17 results at exact head for PR #34 and isolated the last real amendment, closing the verification loop opened earlier in the day. [comment on PR #34](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/34#issuecomment-5464257193)

### agent-ercs

_Cross-referencing work moved into a concrete diff-and-confirm phase._

- Zexo **Diffed** all four files against the upstream merge commit, providing a line-level comparison that grounds the agent-ercs implementation in the canonical ERC source. [comment on PR #19](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-ercs/pull/19#issuecomment-5461021155)

### ERC-8183

_A forum thread surfaced a new hook-pattern possibility worth tracking._

- A discussion post noted that the ERC-8183 spec's evaluator-contract design could support ZK-proof examination as a valid hook, opening a concrete path for verifiable agent-commerce hooks. [ERC-8183 thread](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/395)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Explore how the ZK-proof evaluator hook pattern in ERC-8183 could connect with the group's existing proof-verification infrastructure
- Track the agent-ercs follow-up PR and how it extends the diff work completed today

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Recompute recompute-kit PR #34 outputs against the corrected evidence-axis schema
- Review the agent-ercs follow-up PR once it opens
- Progress agent-sdk PR #23 for the erc-8275 hash-pinned testkit vectors

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A schema correction arrived, was absorbed instantly, correction PRs went up with the gateway held, and exact-head verification closed the loop — all within a single window.
>
> The feedback-to-fix relay ran faster than most CI queues today. Keep that loop tight! 🔁
